findings.title: Generated-key retrieval depends on driver support
findings.description: useGeneratedKeys=true with keyProperty="id" and keyColumn="ID" relies on the JDBC driver returning generated keys. On databases or drivers without identity/generated-key support, or where column ID is not an auto-increment identity, the id will not be populated. This is a static observation; runtime confirmation is required.
findings.recommendation: Confirm COMPANY.ID is an auto-increment/identity column and that the target JDBC driver supports getGeneratedKeys; otherwise read the id via a post-insert SELECT or an explicit <selectKey>.

findings.title: Unchecked java.util.Map parameter contract
findings.description: parameterType=java.util.Map with five #{...} placeholders gives no compile-time safety; a missing key throws a BindingException at runtime and a null value may violate NOT NULL constraints. Static observation only; DB constraints are unverified.
findings.recommendation: Prefer a typed parameter object or @Param-annotated method arguments, and validate required fields before insert.

findings.title: Uppercase identifiers depend on catalog identifier folding
findings.description: Column names are written in uppercase without quoting. On databases that fold unquoted identifiers to lowercase, the DDL identifiers must match. Unverified against the configured catalog.
findings.recommendation: Verify the actual COMPANY column definitions in the target catalog and align identifier casing or quote them consistently.

findings.title: No dynamic SQL branches
findings.description: The statement contains no dynamic nodes and is not injection-prone. Nothing further to review statically.
